method: CPU-only exact source voxel-union boundaries from scan 001; source affine RAS millimetres; labels selected by registered IDs 1-12; no threshold, smoothing, interpolation, decimation or topology repair.

predictions_before_source_run.topology: Measure all edge incidences and vertex links for all 12 exact source voxel unions; do not predict or repair ambiguous discrete contacts.

purpose: Generate lossless voxel-boundary candidates for every registered whole-organ and major-vessel label observed in CT scan 001.
stopping_and_exclusion_rules: This is one frozen source/compiler/runtime/scan/label-set run.
Any source hash, compiler hash, count or volume closure failure remains documented.
Topology is reported exactly as observed; none of these meshes qualifies mask accuracy, cross-scan registration, subject binding, tissue ownership, mechanics, physiology or clinical use.
